text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, good time. My accuracy has 
improved quite a bit.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Shall we take a break soon, then? Whether 
it's running with all your might or 
talking, you need a source of energy, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? This is the cafeteria, right? Why 
is it like this...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I completely forgot. Right, it was 
already that time of year!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Roast chicken and Christmas cake. Ah, and 
there's pizza over there too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Though I suppose expecting curry is asking 
for too much. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I understand that curry is not 
traditionally a Christmas dish, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's just that for Christmas at my house, 
everyone's favorite dishes are laid out 
together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I asked Mother for fruitcake. Brian asked 
me for curry."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was really in a bind when she told me on 
the day of. After all, to make it just the 
way she likes, I have to simmer the 
vegetables for hours...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The date of this year's Arima Kinen is—
choice_data_list:
What do you want to get your little sister 
for Christmas Day?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's true. This year... I want to 
give her the best race ever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
On the stage of the Twinkle Series, with 
both of us in peak condition.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And with my "winning formula," I will 
defeat Brian.
choice_data_list:
You're really not going to let anyone else 
win, are you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Naturally. That's a big sister's pride.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. What is your 
favorite food?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we both eat what we love today 
and bask in utter bliss?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I shared a meal with Biwa 
Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, the snow has piled 
up, hasn't it? Everything happening today 
is just forcing me to be conscious of 
Christmas.
choice_data_list: Your outfit looks pretty Santa-like too
Your outfit looks pretty Santa-like too

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, true. It fits the current mood 
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun. What do you wish 
for on this holy night of miracles? Santa 
might just bring it to you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Please look forward to the day 
of the event.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide smiled with absolute 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I shared a meal with Biwa 
Hayahide—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "...Ummm. Why did you bring me here?"
choice_data_list:
I kind of feel like having some fruitcake 
too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Mmh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You have a tendency to always prioritize 
me. You spoil the Umamusume you train far 
too much.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Let's buy two cakes to take home. One 
for me, and one for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I enjoyed some cake with Biwa 
Hayahide.
